entries.topic: Last Chance 'do you feel anything' trigger
originals: Last Chance Amanda condition
entries.answer: The Last Chance template files Amanda's 'Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?' under 'Connor shot the Tracis in The Eden Club or shot Chloe in Meet Kamski (or both)'. PowerPyx's Last Chance page uses 'You shot the Tracis in The Eden Club (won fight, then chose the Shoot option)', so 'shot the Tracis' covers DEVIANTS DIED as well as CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS. The benchmark's ch29 input counts only CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS, so a won-fight SHOOT (DEVIANTS DIED) never opens C19e or round 4 unless Chloe was shot; its own legacy fallback (choices.C12==='1', the won-fight SHOOT) disagrees with the main branch
entries.source: /tmp/flowcharts/ch20/x_GL.txt lines 145-157; /tmp/flowcharts/ch29/ext PowerPyx text ('won fight, then chose the Shoot option'); benchmark/chapters/ch29.mjs line 50
entries.fix: benchmark/chapters/ch29.mjs inputs.tracisShot (line 50): s.edenOutcome==='CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS' → ['DEVIANTS DIED','CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS'].includes(s.edenOutcome); update tests/ch29.test.mjs line 207-208 to cover DEVIANTS DIED

originals: How long is the interview?
Whether the shutdown can cut the interview short before the fourth prompt
The shutdown timer (TIME BEFORE SHUTDOWN …) is the budget
entries.answer: Four prompts: the template renders CHOICEGROUP01-04, gives the Traci replies for the first three, and only Connor's lines for KILLER / WHAT MODEL / OTHER ANDROID before Hank's 'So, there was another android…'. Only a hesitating player could lose a round to the timer, and the benchmark has no timeouts

originals: Can the second android be missed in the interview?
Whether the second android can be missed in the interview
entries.answer: No. Hank's 'So, there was another android…' follows the fourth prompt unconditionally in the template, and PowerPyx calls the interview unmissable; the Blue Haired Traci page's 'failing to determine that there was actually a second Traci' is outranked
entries.source: transcript.txt lines 172-180; research note §2a/§2b quoting PowerPyx

originals: Memory reset vs give-up prompt
Whether any prompt appears at the memory reset, and whether Hank's CONTINUE / GIVE UP can appear during the chain
entries.answer: The template's 'search-connect-timeout' is an UnlockType.Time heading with Hank SmallDown and lines, no choice group; CONTINUE / GIVE UP belong to the 'Leave the room' timeout before the chain (CHOICEGROUP02 under TRACKGAME.STILLSEARCHING). PowerPyx's 'agree to give up when Hank wants to leave' describes that earlier prompt
